title: Taleggio Lasagna with Australian Spinach
description: A creamy lasagna dish featuring fresh Australian spinach, velvety taleggio cheese, and a rich flavor profile.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add chopped Australian spinach and cook until wilted. Season with salt and black pepper.
In a separate saucepan, melt taleggio cheese over low heat, stirring occasionally.

To assemble the lasagna, create a layer of cooked noodles, followed by a layer of spinach mixture, and then a layer of taleggio cheese. Repeat this process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of taleggio cheese on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
